title: GO Command Center Request V1
description: Human intent submitted as an untrusted proposal through the GitHub control bus. A Request never carries execution parameters and never holds Execution Authority. Command Center resolves every sensitive value deterministically.

request_id.description: Fresh and unique per Request. Reuse is rejected.

action_id.description: The only actions a human may name. ROLLBACK and CANARY are not human-requestable actions.

x-go-notes: pr_number is a target selector, not an execution parameter: Command Center resolves it once to an immutable commit SHA with its own read-only resolver key.
plan_id refers to an operator-registered, human-approved deployment plan read from a fixed root-owned store. The Request cannot supply any value inside that plan.
A Request PR must add exactly one requests/<request_id>.json file and nothing else.
